name: code-optimizer-studio
description: Browser-based code optimizer powered by Phi-3 Mini with TinyLlama fallback.

scripts.install:backend: /usr/bin/python3 -m venv backend/.venv && backend/.venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel && backend/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r backend/requirements.txt
scripts.models:download:phi3: npm run install:backend && backend/.venv/bin/python backend/download_models.py --model phi3
scripts.models:download:tiny: npm run install:backend && backend/.venv/bin/python backend/download_models.py --model tinyllama
